Hi Marie — welcome, and thanks for sending the W-9. Quick read-through and a couple of requests so we can progress the PO: 

Summary of what's needed to move to conditional PO issuance:
- Valid, signed W-9 (received) — will run EIN check against IRS lookup.
- Bank letter (bank_letter_aurora.jpg) or ACH setup form for payment routing.
- Signatory authorization or delegation letter if the person signing the W-9 is not listed as the primary account owner.
- If there are any entity-name / DBA mismatches, we may request a copy of the EIN assignment letter or an invoice sample.

What we can offer now:
- Procurement can issue a conditional PO (one-time / single-invoice) within 48 business hours after we confirm the EIN match and receive a bank letter for ACH. Final PO number will be provided; payment will be scheduled once vendor record completes tax verification.

Optional fast track: Ben can help with a short liveness / video verification and an ACH micro-deposit to speed the bank confirmation — that usually shortens processing to ~24 hours.

Next steps for you: attach a scanned bank letter (on bank letterhead) and confirm the signatory on the W-9 is authorized to sign vendor docs. I’ve attached our vendor_onboarding_form.docx to this thread — please fill Section A–C and return.
